name: Tug-of-War Session Split
note: Holds the same signal in one session and only one. S = close above EMA(ema_n) with ADX(14) >= adx_min, read at the last regular-hours bar of the day. arm=0 (overnight) buys at that closing bar and exits at the next regular-session open, carrying zero intraday exposure; arm=1 (intraday) buys at the regular-session open and exits at that day's close, carrying zero overnight exposure. Neither arm has a stop, target or trail - the session boundary IS the exit, which is the whole point of the test. The signal and its parameters are identical across arms so the only difference is which half of the day the exposure is held in.
source: Lou, Polk & Skouras (2019), 'A Tug of War: Overnight versus Intraday Expected Returns', Journal of Financial Economics 134:192-213 (personal.lse.ac.uk/polk/research/tugofwar.pdf).

import datetime as _dt

_TZB = {}
_TZC = {}
_OPEN_M = 570
_CLOSE_M = 960


def _et(ts):
    """(ET day ordinal, ET minute of day) from a UTC ISO timestamp."""
    k = ts[:13]
    v = _TZC.get(k)
    if v is None:
        u = _dt.datetime(int(ts[0:4]), int(ts[5:7]), int(ts[8:10]), int(ts[11:13]))
        y = u.year
        b = _TZB.get(y)
        if b is None:
            d = _dt.date(y, 3, 1)
            s = _dt.datetime(y, 3, 1 + (6 - d.weekday()) % 7 + 7, 7, 0)
            d2 = _dt.date(y, 11, 1)
            e = _dt.datetime(y, 11, 1 + (6 - d2.weekday()) % 7, 6, 0)
            b = _TZB[y] = (s, e)
        x = u - _dt.timedelta(hours=(4 if b[0] <= u < b[1] else 5))
        v = _TZC[k] = (x.toordinal(), x.hour * 60)
    return v[0], v[1] + int(ts[14:16])


def _ema(x, p):
    n = len(x)
    out = [None] * n
    if p < 1 or n == 0:
        return out
    k = 2.0 / (p + 1.0)
    s = None
    for j in range(n):
        s = x[j] if s is None else s + k * (x[j] - s)
        if j >= p - 1:
            out[j] = s
    return out


def _wilder_dirs(h, l, c, p):
    """ADX, Wilder. Returns a list with None until it has formed."""
    n = len(c)
    out = [None] * n
    if n < 2 * p + 2 or p < 2:
        return out
    tr = [0.0] * n
    pdm = [0.0] * n
    ndm = [0.0] * n
    for j in range(1, n):
        up = h[j] - h[j - 1]
        dw = l[j - 1] - l[j]
        pdm[j] = up if (up > dw and up > 0.0) else 0.0
        ndm[j] = dw if (dw > up and dw > 0.0) else 0.0
        pc = c[j - 1]
        a = h[j] - l[j]
        b = pc - h[j]
        if b < 0.0:
            b = -b
        d = pc - l[j]
        if d < 0.0:
            d = -d
        tr[j] = a if (a >= b and a >= d) else (b if b >= d else d)
    st = 0.0
    sp = 0.0
    sn = 0.0
    for j in range(1, p + 1):
        st += tr[j]
        sp += pdm[j]
        sn += ndm[j]
    dx = [None] * n
    for j in range(p, n):
        if j > p:
            st = st - st / p + tr[j]
            sp = sp - sp / p + pdm[j]
            sn = sn - sn / p + ndm[j]
        if st > 0.0:
            pdi = 100.0 * sp / st
            ndi = 100.0 * sn / st
            s = pdi + ndi
            dif = pdi - ndi
            if dif < 0.0:
                dif = -dif
            dx[j] = 100.0 * dif / s if s > 0.0 else 0.0
    acc = 0.0
    cnt = 0
    prev = None
    for j in range(p, n):
        d = dx[j] if dx[j] is not None else 0.0
        if prev is None:
            acc += d
            cnt += 1
            if cnt == p:
                prev = acc / p
                out[j] = prev
        else:
            prev = (prev * (p - 1) + d) / p
            out[j] = prev
    return out




def family_init(ctx):
    b = ctx.bars
    n = len(b)
    h = [float(x["h"]) for x in b]
    l = [float(x["l"]) for x in b]
    c = [float(x["c"]) for x in b]

    day = [0] * n
    mn = [0] * n
    for j in range(n):
        d, m = _et(b[j]["t"])
        day[j] = d
        mn[j] = m

    bar_min = 5
    for j in range(1, min(n, 200)):
        if day[j] == day[j - 1] and mn[j] > mn[j - 1]:
            bar_min = mn[j] - mn[j - 1]
            break

    ema = _ema(c, max(2, int(ctx.p.ema_n)))
    adx = _wilder_dirs(h, l, c, 14)
    amin = float(ctx.p.adx_min)
    arm = int(ctx.p.arm)

    sig = [0] * n
    carried = 0               # S as read at the previous session's close
    prev_day = None
    done_today = False
    for j in range(n):
        newday = day[j] != prev_day
        if newday:
            prev_day = day[j]
            done_today = False
        m = mn[j]
        rth = _OPEN_M <= m < _CLOSE_M

        if arm == 1:
            # ARM D -- intraday only. Fire on the last pre-open bar so the
            # fill lands on the regular-session open; if the symbol has no
            # pre-market bar that day, fall back to the first RTH bar.
            if not done_today and carried:
                if _OPEN_M - bar_min <= m < _OPEN_M or rth:
                    sig[j] = carried
                    done_today = True
            elif rth:
                done_today = True

        if rth and m >= _CLOSE_M - bar_min:
            # the session's closing bar: read S here, and for ARM N this is
            # also where the overnight leg is bought (the fill lands on the
            # next bar, effectively the close)
            d = 0
            e = ema[j]
            a = adx[j]
            if e is not None and a is not None and a >= amin:
                if c[j] > e:
                    d = 1
                elif c[j] < e:
                    d = -1
            carried = d
            if arm == 0 and d:
                sig[j] = d

    ctx.sg = ctx.series(sig, "tug_sig")
    ctx.day = ctx.series(day, "et_day")
    ctx.mn = ctx.series(mn, "et_min")
    ctx.bar_min = bar_min


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sg[i]
    return s if s else 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    e = ctx.positions[0]["entry_i"]
    d0 = ctx.day[e]
    d1 = ctx.day[i]
    m = ctx.mn[i]
    if d0 is None or d1 is None or m is None:
        return False
    if int(ctx.p.arm) == 0:
        # ARM N -- out at the regular-session open of the next day. The fill
        # lands on the following bar, so fire on the last pre-open bar.
        return d1 != d0 and m >= _OPEN_M - ctx.bar_min
    # ARM D -- out at the close of the same session, never held overnight.
    if d1 != d0:
        return True
    return m >= _CLOSE_M - ctx.bar_min
